build_ensemble_estimator: build a scikit-learn ensemble estimator by subclassing BaseEnsemble with a base estimator and n_estimators count
create_heterogeneous_ensemble: create a heterogeneous ensemble by passing a list of (name, estimator) tuples to _BaseHeterogeneousEnsemble
fit_single_estimator: fit a single estimator with X, y and optional fit parameters like sample_weight using _fit_single_estimator
partition_estimators_for_jobs: partition estimators across parallel jobs using _partition_estimators with n_estimators and n_jobs counts
set_random_states: set reproducible random_state parameters on an estimator using _set_random_states with a seed value
